metadata.title: The Biggest Black Hole Has 100 Billion Suns | Top 20 Largest Black Holes Ever Found
metadata.description:
TON 618 swallowed 66 billion suns. But it's not the biggest. The largest black hole ever discovered has the mass of 100 BILLION suns — and it's still growing.

This is the definitive ranking of the most massive black holes ever found in the observable universe — from supergiant elliptical galaxy cores to ancient quasars billions of light-years away. Every entry is real, measured, and confirmed by modern astronomy. You'll see Phoenix A*, TON 618, IC 1101, the famous M87* imaged by the Event Horizon Telescope, and many more black holes so massive they break the limits of our current physics.

Which one blew your mind? Drop it in the comments — and let me know which black hole you'd most want to see up close (from a safe distance).
